subject: Joint MAP & Security Gate Schedule — NebulaFin evaluation
messages:
From: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@nebulafin.com>
To: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>, ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>
Cc: Tim Park <tim.park@procure.nebulafin.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T09:12:00-08:00
Subject: Draft MAP and initial security gates

Hi Jasmine / Ben —

Thanks again for walking us through Redwood yesterday. As discussed, I attached our working draft of the Mutual Action Plan (MAP) so both sides can align on evaluation milestones and the security/compliance gates we need closed for procurement. High-level asks from NebulaFin:

- SOC 2 Type II report (or in-progress attestations + expected delivery window)
- SIG/CAIQ self-assessment and evidence for the controls marked in red in the attached MAP
- Signed DPA with EU data residency carveouts (we're US-based but have EU customers)
- Data retention specifics: transaction logs 7 years, request logs 90 days, backups 30 days unless otherwise requested

Proposed evaluation timeline in the MAP: evidence sprint -> integration POC -> production canary. Our procurement team wants the security evidence sprint completed before legal will advance redlines. Can Redwood commit to a 2-week evidence sprint window starting Nov 22?

Attached: NebulaFin-MAP-draft-v1.pdf

Olivia Chen
Director, Platform Partnerships
NebulaFin
From: jasmine_liu <jasmine_liu@redwood.com>
To: Olivia Chen <olivia.chen@nebulafin.com>
Cc: ben_carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Tim Park <tim.park@procure.nebulafin.com>
Date: 2026-11-09T10:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Draft MAP and initial security gates

Hi Olivia —

Appreciate the clear MAP draft, and the retention table is very helpful. We can support a focused evidence sprint; suggested approach from our side:

1) Pre-sprint readiness call (Nov 16) to align on leads and evidence owners
2) Evidence sprint (Nov 22–Dec 3) — target: provide SOC 2 scoping docs, SIG/CAIQ responses, and DPA template redlines
3) POC integration week (Dec 6–10)
4) Canary begins (Dec 13) — limited traffic, rollback policy in MAP

Quick clarifications:
- Our current SOC 2 Type II report is in final review and expected to be issued mid-December; we can provide in-scope controls matrix earlier.
- For the DPA, we typically propose a 5-year retention default with per-customer carveouts — happy to take NebulaFin's retention table into the DPA negotiation.

I've attached our acceptance criteria doc (Redwood-MAP-acceptance-criteria-v1.docx) and a SOC2 evidence template to speed the sprint. If procurement needs a shorter window, flag it and we'll try to compress.

Thanks —
Jasmine
Enterprise AE, Redwood Inference

Olivia —

Two operational notes from our security/ops angle:

- Evidence handoff: please point us to a single intake folder (Drive link preferred) and a named contact on your security team. It helps us avoid duplicate asks.
- DPA carveouts: we can accept NebulaFin's proposed transaction log retention of 7 years with a specific clause for purge-on-request for customer-sensitive data, but we need legal to sign off on any deviations from our default 5-year baseline.

Internal: @karthik_iyer can you confirm who on infra will own the SIG/CAIQ checklist responses? Also tagging for any special EU residency requirements that might affect routing.

-ben
